[SWS_FrIf_05057] Upstream requirements: SRS_Fr_05097
⌈It shall be possible that the FrIf module can be configured to support at least four (possibly different) FlexRay Drivers to access the FlexRay Communication Controllers.⌋

⌈It shall be possible that the FrIf module can be configured using the parameter FRIF_ CTRL_IDX to support at least four (possibly different) FlexRay CCs.⌋

⌈It shall be possible that the FrIf module can be configured to support one of both or both FlexRay Channels as specified in [7, FlexRay Communications System Protocol Specification V2.1].⌋

⌈It shall be possible that the FrIf module can be configured using the parameter FRIF_ ABS_TIMER_IDX to support at least one absolute timer per FlexRay CCs.⌋
